crossRefs.note: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”
Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
After a little while someone else saw him, and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”
Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples…
Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of…

translations.web: The maid saw him, and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”
translations.bsb: There the servant girl saw him and again said to those standing nearby, “This man is one of them.”
translations.kjv: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
translations.asv: And the maid saw him, and began again to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
